help.botDescription: Tickly is an unofficial, but [open-sourced]({{githubLink}}), [Todoist]({{todoistLink}}) integration for Discord.

intro.title: ## What is Tickly?
intro.features:
With this bot, you can easily :
- **manage your Todoist tasks** and projects directly from Discord
- [__SOON__] **receive reminders** for upcoming or missed tasks

commands.title: ## Commands
commands.tip: > {{i}} Type `/help [command]` for more details on a specific command.

commandList.startGuidePrompt: > **Need a quick start guide?** Click the following button.

step1.title: ### 1. Installation
step1.body:
Discord bots can be added as **guild install** (in a specific server) or **user install**.

Tickly supports both methods, but **we recommend adding it to your account** so you can use it anywhere in Discord, including all servers and private messages.
To do so, click the ["Add Bot" button]({{inviteLink}}), then chose "Add to my apps":
step1.imageDescription: Click "Add to" to install the bot on your account: "Add to my apps"
step1.note: > Note that some servers may disable user-installed ("external") apps, meaning the bot must be added directly on these servers.

step2.title: ### 2. Sign in to your Todoist account
step2.body:
Run {{loginMention}}, you will be redirected to Todoist OAuth2 login.
After you approve access, Tickly encrypts and stores your Todoist access token in a session for future interactions.
By default, your session expires after 30 days of inactivity — you can change this in `/settings`.

step3.title: ### 3. Add your first task
step3.body:
You can now interact with the bot by using **`/` commands** or **right-clicking on a message**. These commands are available in any text channel — and private message if you have installed Tickly on your account.

To add your first task, use {{addTaskMention}} or right-click a message and go to "Apps".
Both methods open the same window, pre-filled if a message was selected:
step3.addFromMessageImageDescription: Task creation from message by right-clicking on it.
step3.naturalLanguageNote: The add command also supports [natural language processing]({{naturalLanguageLink}}), as a parameter, to create tasks more quickly without opening the modal:
step3.addNaturalLanguageImageDescription: Task creation by using the command with natural language content.
